# META_INSIGHTS — search process summary

- Strategy: Used parallel diagnosis to identify 4 distinct failure clusters (Type Mismatch, Range/Coverage, Logic Error, Formatting).
- Leverage: Found that prompt adherence (XML tags) and type mismatches (strings vs numbers) were low-hanging fruit with high leverage.
- Verifications: Verified against traces 48365 (formatting) and 32438 (type mismatch).
